scope:
Exercise new identity envelopes using original selectors, without a solver.

This fresh-process check installs the original Newton then explicitly selects
the original reviewed release-LU/direct-CSC function objects.  One CSC function
factory is called; no candidate, RHS, Jacobian matrix, LU, Newton, BVP or DN is
called. Original backend namespace references are restored before exit.

before_selection_original_runtime.signature: (n, m, h, col_fun, bc, jac, y, p, B, bvp_tol, bc_tol)

selected_runtime.signature: (n, m, h, col_fun, bc, jac, y, p, B, bvp_tol, bc_tol)

selected.scope: Only runtime identity; no BVP success or memory guarantee.

newton_transition.scope: Explicit process-local change; no original function or STATS object was replaced.

factory_provenance.newton_selection: not read, installed, or validated by this foundation
